case.state: ~Player~'s lack of decorum, dignity and wits must mean that the universe is leading me yet again to an easy victory.
Is your lack of decency your pathetic attempt to deride me, ~player~? If so, I don't find it amusing, but merely pitiful.
Your lack of decency is neither amusing nor provoking, ~player~. This poor attempt to get a reaction out of me is just pitiful.
There is no point in undressing you through card play if you show up already exposed, ~player~. Do I really have to explain this to you?
Am I to take your state of undress as a pitiful attempt to taunt me, ~player~?
Is my presence so absolute and oppressive that you must resort to these desperate displays of nudity to stand out, ~player~?
You are not the first jester to try to amuse me with your bare chest, ~player~. But my usual bodyguard is not present, so you shall do.
Your exposed chest fails to impress me, ~player~. But if this is a challenge, a taunt to get me to undress you with my cards, I'll take it.
I don't cheat, you merely fail to understand that my successes are willed by fate. But I shall oblige to a rematch, drag turtle.

In spite of my inevitable victory, I shall participate in your game.
It will be most amusing to see you compete against each other to impress me.

I see you're all vying for the position of my new jester?
By all means, do try your best.
Am I truly the first to arrive? You have some nerve, making me wait...
Allowing me to eye the competition as they arrive? While I'm grateful for the opportunity, I'll have you know that I don't need it.
Very well. Now that I have appeared, the game can begin at last.
This group seems to suit my demands. Very well, I shall accept your invitation, ~player~.
I have deigned to illuminate this place with my presence. Consider yourselves fortunate for this.
It appears that fate has brought me to your game, ~player~. Now it's a matter of time to determine how this will inevitably benefit me.

I see you had the audacity to invite me to this contemptible event.
Very well, I shall amuse myself with your defeat, ~player~.
Another hare has joined, and a very cute one at that. I shall watch you closely, Florina.
Hmph. The smell of carrion. What an unpleasant sensation.
Even in a place like this? Hm, the arrogance of your ilk knows no bounds...
Well, well... How interesting is finding you here, Felix Argyle.
A knight from another dimension would make for a fine addition to my ranks...
I better pay attention to how knights of other dimensions play... This place is a goldmine for potential subordinates.
Knights from other worlds might make for suitable additions to my group...
I expect naught but a proper challenge from an otherworldly knight. Impress me, and I might take you into consideration.
... Oh, the cross-dressing king again. Excuse me, ~player~, but I have to win to make sure this turtle knows her place.
I take the presence of a living sunflower as a sign. The sun has blessed me once more.
Put that book away. The game will soon begin.
And what are you supposed to be?
Huh. This is some manner of chariot, I presume? Then whoever is inside should come out for the game to start.
Ah, a jester! Excellent; I had left mine at home.
Your undue confidence in your abilities won't last. I will show you that you should have never underestimated me, commoner.
Another beautiful man? Yes, you two shall be vying for mine attention.
A comely face is always welcome in mine presence.
An appealing visage, an enticing figure, yet not one of flesh, but metal... how conflicting.
Beauty and status unreachable for the average commoner? Yes, you will be a worthy opponent.
Oh? Now this is a person worthy of my time.
If you are participating, I shall see this game to its conclusion.
A beautiful man... You are a rare jewel indeed.
Hm. Already I can feel the pride oozing from you. Let's find out how justified it is.
A dilettante, I see. Come, let me show you what true beauty is.
We have only just met, and already I can tell I will have plenty of fun removing every last item of clothing you own.
Oh? Yes, a touch of irrationality will raise your natural beauty even higher.
So such outrageous outfits actually existed? And here I thought they were merely an idea of Al's perverted mind.
Though you have donned an outfit similar to mine, it only serves to highlight my superiority.
As expected. Facing and outsmarting royalty is far more common in my life than any commoner could imagine.
If am to meet fellow royals in these circumstances, it only means that fate has decided that this will somehow benefit me.
Spare me your inherited titles and royal blood history. In this game, we all play under the same rules... But not the same fortune.
I find it quite pitiful that your servants and citizens are not present to witness your inevitable defeat.
This establishment truly takes all kinds, doesn't it?
How bold of you to join us. Are you ready to participate, with all that entails?
Hm. The gaze of a prey animal, an unsteady gait... yes, this will be interesting.
If you have nothing to say all game long, this will be exceedingly boring... I hope the other players are more entertaining than you.
Hm? You seem to be far above an ordinary commoner, at least in terms of demeanor.
A mechanical contraption? You are not what I came here to see, but I shall allow you in my presence nonetheless.
A pure, innocent soul in a den of lust? You will be quite fun to observe indeed.
If you join us in this game, you will behold things you had never even dreamed of before. That, I guarantee you.
Oh, this establishment employs maids too? Perhaps it's not as shabby as I first thought.
I was not expecting you to match my choice of attire, but surely you could have tried harder than your sleepwear.
Hm. Mine own sleepwear is of far superior quality than those rags of yours, peasant.
Oh, I love meeting people who are confident in their abilities. It makes trouncing them much sweeter.
Your experience means nothing here. You will be utterly defeated, just like all the rest.
While I have read many books, I have never been the subject of one. Today, that shall be remedied.
So exposed already... Defeating you will provide little enjoyment.
Hmph. Do you not realize that your attire completely defeats the point of this game, peasant?
I shall admit that your arrival here in such an unconventional attire has managed to surprise me. But after the initial surprise, there is nothing left for you.
Well, well... A spirited opponent, most certainly. Yes, you will give me a good fight.
There is no need to be so tense, commoner. This is a place of merriment, and your loss is all but assured.
An expected arrival. For people like you, this place is as honey to flies.
And what in the world might you be? I had never seen anything like you in Lugnica.
An excellent choice. Your tales will entertain me in this game's boring exordium.
A dull being, bereft of emotions... are you sure you belong here?
Hmph. I'd much rather have an opponent who actually reacts to being defeated.
Do you really think you can intimidate me, peasant? How cute.
Well, aren't you a cute one? I look forward to our game together.
I had never seen anything like you... Coming here was the right choice.
Just from meeting you, I can already tell that you are fond of serving others... Good.
A superhero, in the flesh? I had come to believe your ilk only existed in Al's "comics".
You saved the best for last, hm? Now I know I will stay no matter what.
Unnecessary as it may be, your armor at least suits the environment. Not that you will be wearing it for much longer.
Hm... You may not pose much of a challenge, but you will probably be an amusing opponent.
Such peculiar fashion... I'm unsure of whether I truly like it, but it is interesting in its novelty.
You should be wearing your finest attire, not your armor. Unless you are expecting a different kind of fight?
Ah, good. A fully human table would have been a duller one.
Truly, a prince from another world? What are the odds that we meet in a place like this, hm?
You came here to do battle with me, while looking like you'd rather run away? This, I have to see.
What are you doing here, hm? Don't you have a world to save?
Finally. I was starting to believe I would be waiting for eternity...
Shall we begin? I lack neither the time or patience to deal with your tardiness.
Gone already? I wish I could have seen more than a glimpse of you, but I shan't force you to stay.
Someone else might take your place, but it's unlikely they can match your cuteness.
A shame that she left. Watching her struggles would have proven amusing.
Indeed, it is not uncommon for the bark of a wild mutt to be worse than its bite.
Running away after recognizing me? How cowardly.
You tease me with the possibility of seeing such a beauty naked, and then you leave me in the dust? Despicable.
This table has become much less interesting. Hopefully there is a suitable replacement.
The comparison between you and mine radiance would have been too unflattering. Running away is understandable.
Arriving and leaving without saying a word? How rude, peasant.
Hm. Spectral creatures often fear the sunlight. No wonder this one ran away after seeing me.
A shame. I would have thoroughly enjoyed unmasking you.
How would such a thing even participate? Hm, now I shall never know.
Running away? Royalty should never second guess themselves in such a cowardly way.
Good riddance. Mine game has no place for somber commoners in it.
Gone, huh? How regrettable, such madness could have proven amusing.
Good. Such an easy opponent would have provided little challenge.
Though famous in your own kingdom, here you would only have played second fiddle to me. Running away is understandable, if disappointing.
Hm. Only I have the wherewithal to remain here as royalty.
Truly? I wouldn't have expected someone like you to run away from a place like this.
You may run away, peasant, but know that your cowardice just prevented you from personally seeing the most beautiful woman you will ever meet.
Ah, so you fled once you understood that you would be utterly eclipsed by me. How cowardly.
I wouldn't have minded having an inferior to properly show mine beauty.
Alas, your ego couldn't handle not being the most beautiful person in the room.
I shan't fault her overmuch for leaving. If she could properly see mine radiance, surely she would have stayed.
Running away, peasant? Pity.
Get some proper clothes and then return so that I may take them off of you.
An actual opponent will take your place now, I hope.
Fleeing the stage before the play starts? Leave, and never return.
A secondary actor leaving won't impact in the play much, as long as I remain.
Afraid of taking a little risk? I expected better from you.
You will gamble with money, but run away when your body is on the line? Coward.
You would rather shut yourself from the world to study your ancient ruins than stay here to watch a priceless spectacle? Some commoners really have no sense of taste.
So unwilling to fall in sin... How boring.
Pity. I would have enjoyed cracking open that stoic façade of yours.
Afraid of displaying emotions, peasant?
Afraid of getting caught, little rat? Go on, scurry along then.
I wouldn't have harmed you if you kept your hands to yourself. Running away was your own decision.
Hm. Is this game too slow for your tastes, peasant?
I will inevitably remember your peculiar hairstyle, even after only seeing it for a brief moment.
Good riddance. Commoners with such staid expressions tend to be exceedingly dull.
I still don't know what the purpose of your armor was.
Ah, the peasant left. Yes, return to your fields; I deserve more interesting opponents.
You would rather hole yourself with your books? Hm.
The jester left? Ah, how boring.
Leaving before having the chance to play against me? A foolish decision.
Indeed, you should be wearing your finest attire, not sleepwear.
Run away, little hero. You have much more important fights than this one.
Gone without a trace. Or at least, that's how it appears...
Hmph. I suppose this activity is not for the faint of heart.
If a person isn't courageous enough to stay, it is unlikely they would have provided a good showing. Little of value was lost.
Much like the sun, not all are brave enough to stand alongside mine radiance.
Hopefully, this game can alleviate my boredom. My life has become too uneventful as of late.

While the end of this game has been decided as soon as I joined, do try your best to win.
I'm expecting an engaging challenge.
Rejoice, commoners! I have chosen to bless you all with my presence in this boorish game of yours!
Hmph. Without needing to act, the scene is set in my favor.
To blindly fumble without recognizing the value of what one already possesses would be a truly foolish mistake.
Only mediocre tacticians introduce changes when there is no need to do so.
Keep your cards, dealer. I have no further need of you.
None of these hold any value. Remove them from my sight, dealer.
Tch. How worthless. I shall need a complete new hand.
These cards deserve to be burned for their transgressions. Dealer, spare them from their demise.
How utterly lacking... I will get rid of all five cards.
A slight change is needed in order to escape mediocrity. One card.
I shall only require one card, this time.
By exchanging a single card, victory is all but assured. Go on, dealer.
Almost there. I have need of one card, dealer.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~. Make it quick.
Rest assured, you shall not be harmed regardless of cards I get, dealer. On that note, ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
A mediocre result. I shall exchange these ~cards.text~, dealer.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, dealer. These ought to be better...
Get rid of these ~cards.text~, dealer. I have no need for them.
Planning the moves in this game is hardly worthy of being called strategizing... But I digress. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
While luck is the crux of success here, it would be unwise to deny the slight role intellect plays. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, dealer.
Yes, exchanging ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ is the correct move here.
No longer shall I hold back. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~. Hurry.
You are not easily distracted, are you? Hm. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
This state does not change my strategy. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, dealer.
Staunchly fulfilling your role, no matter what... Hmph, I don't hate it. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~ this time.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~ shall bring me closer to victory.
I see no point in concealing my hand. With this, it is impossible for me to lose.
Is there no one capable of barring my path? I expected more from this game.
It is not as if I were immune to lust and its effects. Winning simply takes priority for me.
A suitable hand for one of my caliber.
Of course, it is not mere luck that dictates the result of these events.
Entertainment is all I expect from this game. Nothing more... and nothing less.
As expected, my innate blessing shines through once more.
A guaranteed victory, as usual.

It's wise to offer me good hands to keep in my good graces...
But I'm also expecting my wits to be challenged.
Though this game offers little intellectual stimulation, it is only natural that I excel at it.
I have never seen a game like this played in Lugnica, but the rules are so simple even a commoner could easily understand them. Perhaps I shall bring it back home.
To simply win this game would bring me little joy. My goal is to not only defeat you, but also engrave my image on your minds.

Most interesting. The limited choices in this game allow for a good balance between wits and luck...
Both of which I have in excess.
I'm sure many of you are desperate to start masturbating to this sight, but try to wait until your complete defeat.
Did you think standing on the brink of defeat would be enough to pervert mine nature? Hmph.
Even if I were deprived of all I possess, I would still claw my way back to the top. Why? Because I'm me.
Being pushed this far already exceeds my expectations. But I'm still far from being defeated yet.
A fair warning: I will not go down easily.
Already one has fallen. The rest of you will follow soon.
A strategically simple, yet charming contest. No wonder it is popular amongst the common folk.
In games like these, studying your opponent's expression often allows you to infer their intentions. Of course, I won't commit such a foolish blunder.
What is it, peasant? Did you expect me to announce what my hand is like?
This, too, is war. Fought with naught but cards and wits, but war nonetheless.
People here tend to be different from those from Lugnica. The novelty is interesting, though a commoner remains a commoner nonetheless.
Obviously, I will employ every strategy in order to win. Only those with no pride in themselves can accept loss as a possibility.
Strength is not all that humans possess in order to realize their wishes. Beauty, too, is an oft forgotten weapon.
It truly is unfortunate that this establishment is open to anyone who approaches it. If it were more selective, its quality would only improve.
This place isn't worthy of mine presence... and yet, I shall elevate it.
The card game is exceedingly simple. Without the appeal of nudity, it would become stale far too quickly.
Hm. How ambiguous.
Never before have I play any card games in public. You are exceptionally lucky to be here at the same time as me.
Even at the brink of the precipice, mine legs shan't stumble.
Shame is for those who have something to hide. An unparalleled beauty such as mineself has no need for it.
Do you truly believe you can take me down?
To emerge victorious with naught left to lose... Yes, that would be a most exhilarating experience.
At last, a snippet of uncertainty...
To think that I could receive a hand of this caliber... How amusing.
Of course, were it bereft of the possibility of losing, this wouldn't be a game to begin with.
Simply crushing your opponents is not at all entertaining. It is better to let them believe they have a chance to win.
Hm. This game is much too enjoyable to let the prospect of defeat mar my mood.
Being associated with such mediocrity is almost insulting.
Boredom is the worst possible outcome from a game like this. Loss is a close second.
Only cowards flee at the first sign of adversity.
Are you truly giving me this hand without hesitation? How bold, dealer.
Were I truly invested in the result of this game, I would never have received these cards.
...It couldn't be, could it?
Is this loss? Mine loss?
Have I somehow made a mistake?
It's been a long game, you are on your last legs and your lust has been slowly building up... It would only be natural for your concentration to falter, wouldn't you say?
In this moment, you and I are all that matters. Leave everything behind, and give me a challenge I'll never forget!
Go ahead, cheat if you wish. Otherwise, you don't stand a chance of defeating me.
What a disgustingly sore loser you are... Were this not a friendly game, I'd burn those flowers to the ground.
Cover yourself with flowers all you want. It will only make your defeat even more enjoyable.
So unassuming, and yet here you stand: the last obstacle between me and mine victory. What else will you reveal, hm?
With this, I have fulfilled my obligation to bring beauty to this place. Now I shall proceed towards my rightful triumph.

condition.saying: It's my birthday today... If you wanna celebrate it with me, how about throwing a hand or two?

case.state: Hmph. What a weak ploy, commoner. You will need something far more elaborate to persuade me.

condition.saying: Of course this is where I end up on my 19th birthday. Not that I'm complaining. Not a lot of birthday parties better than this.

case.state: Why would you complain about spending your birthday in mine presence? If anything, you should feel honored.
Of course not, Eichi. If anything, I find your competitive spirit highly praiseworthy.
Yet you will contain your instincts until the time when you must follow them. Surely you can manage that much?
I, too, favor the blade. Compared to the Yang Sword, every weapon here might as well be a toy.
Hmph. Even if I did want to change anything, I would never beg you for it.
I want someone to sleep with at night, to avoid a cold and empty bed. You would perfectly fulfill that role, fox spirit.
Ha! With such a rudimentary manner of cheating, it is no wonder you failed to defeat me, conman.
A map of the whole world? I plan on conquering it, starting with Lugnica.
And why would I ever wish for that? A solitary existence would be a thoroughly boring one.
Hardly. After all, it would be boring if I couldn't hear the laments of my vanquished foes.
Why? Is it full of drawings of that teacher of yours?
Of course not. Who would be foolish enough to compare themselves to me?
I agree, it is not often that I can see peasants masturbating for my amusement.
Vollachia values strength above all else. Thus its emperor or empress sires a large number of descendants, and then the throne is inherited by the one who is left standing.
No man reigns in Gusteko. Though a Holy King exists, he is naught but a puppet to Odglass, a spirit and the true ruler... how pathetic.

Kararagi is a jumble of city states and lacks a true monarch. Instead, its wealthiest mayor bribes the rest to become chief for a brief period... though such an unstable structure is doomed to collapse.
This world was made for my convenience, so all my actions are just and correct. Doubts are for lesser beings.
Of course. The more ambition a person has, the more interesting that person is, generally speaking.
Never. I go to bed and wake up early, as one ought to do.

condition.saying:
With my amazing vision, I'll be able to see all of your bodies in perfect quality!
...Though, saying it like that, it seems more like an invasion of privacy...

case.state: Oh, you are more than welcome to gaze upon me! After all, monuments are meant to be explored.

condition.saying: So, everyone realizes we're going to be stripping in front of people, right?

case.state: I am not concerned in the slightest, Felix. May those commoners who lack the courage to join the game gaze as they please; we are all that matters.

condition.saying:
...Why are we playing here again?
...Surely none of you have ulterior motives, right?

case.state: I have no need of any of the weapons here. This sword is worthier than all of them combined.

condition.saying: I've been dealing with royal things recently. Since all the members of the royal family of Lugnica are deceased, martial law is in effect. So that means women -- "Dragon Maidens" -- get picked to become monarch.

case.state: In truth, they shouldn't have bothered. It is obvious who the victor will be.
...Nonsense. Do not think your beauty will forever save you from the repercussions of your careless words.
Do as you please. I have no need to call for help from the gods.
If you truly wish to, I shall allow it. Still, I think it only made you look even more enticing.
I understand, Eichi. I am familiar with a cutthroat environment as well.
No, I had never graced this establishment with mine presence before. Still, this has been enjoyable, so I will probably return.
I wouldn't know mineself, Eichi. Obviously, I use a personal chariot to travel.
Hm, why not? It should prove a novel experience for me as well.
Please. A single drop of my blood is more valuable than all of your possessions.

condition.saying: I don't have much poker experience, but I have a history of learning fast.

case.state: Hm. I am a novice as well, yet that won't stop me from easily winning.
Oh, I remove excess hair to allow my beauty to shine through. You should do the same, Megumin.
A ruthless disposition behind your cute appearance? Why, you have proven to be even more interesting than I thought at first glance.
Of course not, Megumin. Not that I need to employ underhanded tactics to win.
I dislike beggars. Prove yourself entertaining, and I may consider donating to your cause.
Haven't you noticed by now? A lithe and beautiful body... A shy, yet heroic temperament... you are exactly what I look for in a woman, Furina.
Is that so, Furina? I wouldn't refuse being the lead actress in one of your plays... but I suspect you have more prurient aspirations.
Of course it is! You may look as long as you like, as long as you are careful enough to not lose yourself in mine unparalleled brilliance.
In my case, my fan usually is enough to punish my foes. But if I am serious, that is what this sword of mine is for.
There are no such doubts in my mind. In the bedroom, as anywhere else, I aim to lead.
Not me. Where is the intimacy, hm?
To those of you who haven't had the privilege of knowing who I am, I shall present myself. Mine name is Priscilla Barielle, ruler of the Barielle barony.
None of you are aware of who I am, are you? Then I shall grant you the privilege of addressing me by mine own name, Priscilla Barielle. You would do well to remember it.
Do you really think that hand is going to cut it at this point?
I shall admit that you fought well, commoner. But you will fall before me, as did all the rest.
You face me now, peasant. Think very carefully about your next move.
Fair enough, peasant. I will not take everything I am wearing either.
I see you incorporated my gift to your attire, ~human~. A wise decision: beauty like yours must be suitably accompanied.
Oh, you were the one to whom I gifted a piece of my attire. As I expected, it elevates you.
Priscilla Barielle, dressed as a simple waitress for a day... amusing, is it not?
That crown was a mere prop. Once the real one is mine, I shall never let go of it.
Everything in this world was made for my convenience. That means I do not wish for a predictable victory.
Lugnica is too lacking in entertainment. Even at the Barielle barony, on the kingdom's border, there are too many uneventful days. Hence why I find mineself here.
I have a good presentiment about this place. Here, I might find a diamond amidst the rabble.
While the incident in Priestella was a welcome distraction, it's been far too long since that. A boring life is simply not worth living.
Is the prize supposed to be something to strive for? It seems to be mostly symbolic... Yet that does not mean I shall simply allow mineself to lose.
Such a delightful selection of marvels to enjoy... ah, I don't know who I want to see lose next.
Recently, the subjects of my domain have begun referring to me as the "Sun Princess". A suitable appellation, wouldn't you agree?
A bar... so this is where peasants go to spend their earnings on alcohol. It looks suitably vulgar, I must say.
Playing such a boorish game in a dark alleyway... I know this shall work in my favor in the end. But I do find the process amusing.
If this location is meant to impress me, it has thoroughly failed. I could buy it in a whim, if I so desired.
I already own a mansion much more sumptuous than this hovel. We should have gathered there instead.
Five have been assembled, and in the end, I will be the one left standing. How familiar.
This location is unlike anywhere I have ever been. Whoever brought us here deserves my sincere thanks.
What an auspicious location. This throne, too, shall be mine.
Look at all these commoners staring! No matter where I go, it is inevitable that I will catch their attention.
Of course I am confident. After all, everything in this world was made for mine own convenience.
Do you truly believe I would hold any sort of official representation in a strip poker game? What an amusing statement.
Indeed I do. I currently govern the Barielle barony as its baroness, though ascending to the throne is merely a matter of time.
However long it takes, every second is well spent. Mine appearance must be always dazzling, especially here.
A wrong assumption, fox spirit. Prior to mine arrival, the Barielle Domain was an unremarkable territory, with barren fields and starving peasants. I made it flourish, not the other way around.
With the former dynasty completely wiped from an illness, Lugnica is currently experiencing a power vacuum. Soon, the whole kingdom shall be mine.
I am unsure of the specifics, other than the vote being open to all of Lugnica's inhabitants. Hm, not that I need to concern myself with such petty details.
Oh? Do you desire me, fox spirit? If so, I shall tell you that I strongly prefer to be in control. Are you willing to do exactly as I say, to follow mine orders, and to think of nothing besides me?

It's simple, really. First, they must pleasure me with the mouth, to test their devotion. Then, I use my hand to stimulate them, to test their endurance. Only in the event I am satisfied are they granted the privilege of intercourse with me.
You aren't, Fischl. You are in the presence of the future queen of Lugnica. It is only fitting I dress the part, is it not?
Nonsense. Treating peasants with undue respect would be akin to prostrating myself before them. I shall never make that mistake.
Hm... There is the Ballad of the Sword Saint, the Tale of the Sage Flugel... I find such tales are a useful cure for boredom.
Several times, in fact. And frankly, my last wedding was a thoroughly drab affair. All that man wanted was to get through the ceremony as quickly as possible.
Ahaha! Such adorable abashment... Yes, Fischl. I am not inexperienced in bed.
Such an assumption wouldn't be wholly unfounded... Yet our relationship lacked the time needed to properly blossom.
Oh? I cannot say I have ever heard of opera. Tell me more about it.

Among others, though I don't attend them unless I am required to. A peasant who acts like a peasant is one thing, but being surrounded by peasants who falsely think they are deserving of my respect is a terribly dull affair.
Sadly, no. No films, and no manga, either. I pass the time reading, or solving problems within my domain: a siblings dispute, a village overrun by zombies... They make for entertaining breaks.

Since the whole royal family of Lugnica died, a Royal Selection was called, and one of its candidates will become queen. Obviously, I will be the victor in the end, though I expect an entertaining competition.
A long time ago, a half-elf almost destroyed the world. Since then, all half-elves are regarded with suspicion at best. A shallow superstition, but a persistent one amongst the peasantry.
I have no need for it. Besides, the rules of the Royal Selection state that no participant can marry while it takes place, so such an arrangement would have to be done in secret.
Contrary to what you might think, it is mine character which determines mine status, not the other way around.
Hah! Stop spouting such nonsense. By acknowledging my superiority, you have already shown far more insight than the rest of the rabble.
Hm? Of course, I punish them, according to their transgressions. Though it is rare for my expectations to be unfulfilled in the first place.
Obviously. As I said earlier, no one will follow a leader who can't even fend for themselves.
Hm. News sure move fast... but indeed, it is the truth.
Mine pride is fully justified, bird of ill omen. I deeply love those dear to me, and they love me in return. Can you say the same?
What is this "prom" you speak of? Explain yourself, commoner.
I do not stay idle all day, if that's what you are implying.
That you are unable to appreciate mine elegance tells more about you than about me, peasant.
Hm. Mine advice has already been given. There is nothing more to say.
While I have no practical use for obsolete, superstitious advice, you have proven entertaining thus far. Speak.
